verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Stripe-native capability for users to define their own event-triggered rules or automations. Webhooks and event destinations (including EventBridge and Event Grid) only deliver events; they are developer building blocks, and any rules would run on the host platform. Kyber's no-code workflow builder is a third-party app in the Stripe Apps marketplace, not Stripe's own feature. Smart Retries is a fixed built-in automation, not something users configure as rules.
